newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Sidex plans $200 mln bonds, $100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Romania Sidex plans $200 mln bonds, $100 mln loan.

text.p: Romania's Sidex SA steel mill, East Europe's major steel plate producer, plans to raise up to $200 million in Eurobonds through Merrill Lynch and seeks a $100 million loan, an official said on Friday.
Ion Florentin, president of the private Siderman company which ensures Sidex's s management, told reporters the issue might become operational within the next three months.
He said he had disscussed details of the deal with Merrill Lynch representatives in London last week.
Merrill Lynch officials were not available for comment.
Sources at the state-owned plant in Galati, 200 kilometres east of Bucharest, said the funds would be used to upgrade Sidex's equipments.
Florentin also said Sidex was seeking a credit worth $100 million for "production purposes".
"This loan might be a syndicated one. One of the banks involved could be Credit Suisse First Boston. We want the government to guarantee this credit," he said.
Florentin said recently the plant needed some $1.5 billion over the next 10 years to modernise.
Last year Sidex contributed some 60 percent to Romania's total steel output of some 6.0 million tonnes.

Romania won its first credit ratings from major agencies in March. Japan Credit Rating agency awarded it a BB-plus score, somewhat higher than the BB- minus ratings of Standard and Poor's and IBCA and BA-three from Moody's Investors Service.
